name: vesper-desktop
description: macOS Electron desktop client for Vesper

scripts.pack:mac: npm run build && CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY=false electron-builder --mac dir --config electron-builder.yml
scripts.dmg: npm run build && CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY=false electron-builder --mac dmg --arm64 --config electron-builder.yml
scripts.dmg:universal: npm run build && CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY=false electron-builder --mac dmg --universal --config electron-builder.yml
